title: kate-core: test an offset against every selection
summary: Selections::any_covers is true when one stored selection covers the offset. A caret covers nothing. Linux CI runs the test.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add any_covers on Selections. Return true when iter finds a selection whose covers method returns true. A caret covers nothing, so a caret-only set returns false. A range covers an offset at the minimum and before the maximum. The maximum is outside. Use the existing covers method. Leave Selection::covers unchanged. The test any_covers_is_half_open uses Selections::single for a caret at offset 1 and asserts false for offset 1. It then builds Selections::new with ranges 1..3 and 5..7 and primary 0. Offsets 1 and 6 return true. Offsets 3, 4, and 0 return false. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep this change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: selection::tests::any_covers_is_half_open
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because any_covers does not exist. A caret at 1 covers nothing. The range 1..3 covers 1 and 2. The range 5..7 covers 6. Offsets 0, 3, and 4 return false.
